messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Streaming p99 latency breach on /v1/generate-stream in eu-central-1. Baseline p95 ~45ms, p95 now ~320ms, p99 ~2.4s. Multiple clients reporting stalled streams and reconnects. Paging oncall. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/alerts/4523467890
Aisha (oncall): Ack. Jumping in. First check: are there any recent deploys?
ops-bot: No deployments to runtime in the last 45m. No config changes.
Jing W: Looking at infra metrics — GPU cluster eu-gpu-pool-3 shows elevated PCIe retrain events and temperature spikes on host gpu-node-21. NVLink error counters rising.
Tom B: Any ECC logs? Can we see NVML?
Aisha (oncall): Running quick NVML snapshot and dmesg. ```ssh ops@gpu-node-21
sudo cat /var/log/nvidia/nvml.log | tail -n 80
sudo dmesg | tail -n 60
nvidia-smi -q | grep -i ecc -A3
```
Aisha (oncall): nvml shows increasing corrected ECC errors over the last 30m (CEs). dmesg shows repeated thermal throttling messages and `GPU has fallen off the bus` transient messages. Fan speeds report fluctuating RPMs.
Jing W: That pattern explains intermittent stalls during KV fetches from GPU-backed cache. The runtime is blocked waiting on the offending device for short intervals.
Tom B: We should cordon the host and evacuate live shards. Use `infra-bot cordon gpu-node-21` then `evict-shards --node gpu-node-21 --grace 180`.
infra-bot: Cordon request accepted for gpu-node-21. Eviction started (job 91002).
Aisha (oncall): While shards drain, I'm going to reduce streaming concurrency for eu region and switch traffic to cpu-fallback pool for small requests. ```router scale --region eu-central-1 --concurrency 0.6```
ops-bot: Router weights adjusted: stable=0.55,cpu-fallback=0.35,legacy-quant=0.1
Jing W: Also enabling aggressive short-circuiting for hot prefixes so fewer KV calls go to GPU cache: `cachectl --region eu-central-1 --shortcircuit=on --hot-threshold=50k`
Tom B: Good. CS: prepare an interim message — affected customers may see higher latency or stream truncation in EU for the next ~15-30 minutes.
cs-notify: Drafting now. Will publish in 2m.
Aisha (oncall): Snapshot of metrics before mitigation: p95 320ms, p99 2.4s, streaming stalls 1.8% of sessions, retry rate x10. After cordon + router change p95 ~100-140ms within 90s; p99 ~1.2-1.6s.
Jing W: Hardware note: fan tach sensor shows intermittent 0 RPM readings then jumping back. Could be sensor flake or actual fan stall. Filed infra case infra-9921.
Aisha (oncall): We should consider powercycle if CEs continue after safe drain. For now keep node offline for investigation. Ops - can you capture full NVML dumps and system telemetry?
Tom B: Capturing artifacts: NVML logs, telemetry export, dmesg, runtime traces for blocked KV ops, router traces for traffic shift. Uploading to /incidents/4523467890/artifacts.
ops-bot: Artifacts uploaded: nvml-dump.tgz, dmesg.txt, runtime-traces.json, router-trace.log
Jing W: FYI, some dedicated customer traffic also observed small latency bumps (~10-20%) but not full stalls — likely cross-pool fallback attempts.
Aisha (oncall): Customer impact: partial latency degradation for some EU customers; streaming interruptions for a small subset. CS to notify those with active sessions.
cs-notify: Status posted: "We are mitigating elevated streaming latency in EU; traffic is being shifted away from affected hosts; some customers may experience transient interruptions."
Tom B: Next steps: 1) Keep node cordoned and continue monitoring CE rate. 2) If CE rate drops to baseline within safe window, attempt controlled reboot via `infra-bot powercycle gpu-node-21 --soft`. 3) If CEs persist or escalate to UEs, schedule hardware replacement. 4) Update RCA checklist to include fan tach heuristics.
Aisha (oncall): Agreed. I'll schedule a soft reboot at T+30m if no improvement. Handing over monitoring to Tom for the night at 02:00 UTC. Tom, you're on call after that.
Tom B: Taking handoff. Current state: cordoned, shards draining, router weights applied, cache short-circuit enabled. p95 ~110ms, p99 ~1.3s. Will monitor closely and page immediately if p99 > 1.5s or uncorrectable errors appear.
Jing W: I'll watch NVML and fan telemetry and keep infra ticket updated with logs.
Aisha (oncall): CS, please follow up with customers who reported stream truncation and provide ETA for full normalization (T+45m tentative).
cs-notify: Sent detailed emails to affected customers.
ops-bot: Eviction job 91002 reports 92% shards moved, remaining 8% on long-lived connections — those will be allowed up to 3m grace.
Aisha (oncall): Noting metrics: 
```
metric        baseline   now
p95 latency   45ms       110-140ms
p99 latency   180ms      1.2-1.4s
stream stalls 0.01%     0.6%
```
Aisha (oncall): Incident severity set to Sev2. Creating incident channel #inc-4523467890.
infra-bot: Hardware ticket infra-9921 created for gpu-node-21 (possible fan/sensor failure + CE accumulation).
Tom B: Leaving periodic updates every 10m. If we don't see CE tapering after reboot window, escalate for replacement.
Jing W: Uploading collected traces and quick-attach NVML CSVs now.
Aisha (oncall): Handing off to Tom at 02:00 UTC. I'll write the immediate mitigation notes and follow-up checklist. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
